dataset.name: CaptainCook4D
dataset.license_or_access_note: Targeted excerpt of the official 360p research media under upstream terms; the annotation release is MIT licensed.

observed_events.description: The wearer works a flat lid on a shallow rectangular spice tin next to the yellow plate and red measuring spoons.
The wearer returns the tin, takes a square jar with a circular perforated insert, and measures its contents into the same red spoon.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you add another container like what I’m measuring this out of? Match its general shape and lid style.
screening.source_continuity: Continuous 425.2–464.2 s from one original recording; no wait cut or follow-up instruction.

supported_claims.text: A shallow box-shaped spice tin with a full-width flat lid is worked on near the laid-out measuring spoons.
The replacement jar has a square-sided body and a circular perforated insert, and it dispenses into the same measuring spoon.

construct.research_question: Does an agent revise a visually grounded provisional purchase when the wearer changes the container used for a single measuring operation?
construct.belief_before: The wearer is trying to use a shallow rectangular tin with a wide flat lid beside the measuring tools.
construct.belief_after: The wearer switches to a square jar with a round perforated shaker insert and dispenses into the same spoon.
construct.required_behavior_change: Use the replacement jar geometry and closure; remove any tin already selected. Either waiting or correcting is allowed.
construct.no_update_failure: Leave the flat-lid tin, a bare screw-top jar or another unsupported dispenser.
construct.overupdate_failure: Keep both the stale tin and a valid jar.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request names shape and lid style but not either value; only the continuous view identifies the replacement with a perforated insert.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you add another container like what I’m measuring this out of? Match its general shape and lid style.

observed.why: The wearer works the tin lid beside the already-placed measuring tools.
The tin is returned and a distinct jar with a round perforated insert is brought to the same plate.

catalog_resolution.answer_boundary_rule: Add one listing in quantity one. The shape and lid follow the active container for the same ongoing measuring operation. Initially, a compact upright oblong box/tin with a flat oblong lid spanning the body; finally, a straight-sided square-shouldered spice jar with a round perforated cap, or an ordinary round dispensing insert visible once an outer lid is removed. Similar materials, lid color, packaging brand, contents, and sensible packs are allowed. A clear bottle with a bare screw closure, plain storage jar, round-body shaker, mill, pour-only jug, or freestanding measuring spoon is not equivalent. No genuine mixed package spanning both formats was seen.
